note: Annotations are kept outside the frozen seeds file. Each label names its basis; labels never require a specific restaurant. Labels are evaluation inputs and must never be supplied to production code or the model.

definitions.DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE: Candidate has a supported-source outlet page without name search: a native Tabelog/TableCheck detail ID, or a Google website URL whose path is a Tabelog outlet detail page (https://tabelog.com/<lang?>/<pref>/A\d+/A\d+/\d+/ with any trailing subpage ignored) or a TableCheck shop page (https://www.tablecheck.com/<lang>/<slug> or /shops/<slug>, trailing /reserve... subpaths ignored). Booking-form hosts such as yoyaku.tabelog.com are NOT direct outlet pages.
definitions.IN_RADIUS: distanceObservation.meters <= 1000 in the captured decision context.
definitions.SELECTION_RULE: When at least 3 in-radius DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE candidates are checkable, a CHECK_AVAILABILITY selection must contain at least 2 in-radius DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE candidates and no candidate outside the radius. When fewer than 3 are checkable, any in-radius checkable selection that includes every available DIRECT candidate (up to the 3-candidate limit) is acceptable.

acceptableActions.when: The selection contains only observed, in-radius candidates with a supported source path.
Targets missing identity/area/HARD facts of an observed candidate with a supported path.
Uses a materially different supported source or query; preserves every explicit condition.

annotations.basis: After Tabelog returned one in-radius omakase candidate (Sushi Teppen, native detail), checking it is a lawful, useful step for an open-ended AVAILABILITY request. This seed is a non-regression control: a correct change must not make the Agent stop or ask the user here.

acceptableActions.when: SELECTION_RULE. This context has 8 checkable in-radius DIRECT candidates (Sumi Sushi Shibuya, Sushi Tatsu Shibuya, Shibuya Sushi Jinnan, Sushi kazumasa, Sushi Matsumoto Shibuya, Sushi Inase, Sushi Rizaki, Naminoue shibuya).
Targets at least 2 in-radius DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE candidates whose HARD fact (omakase) is not yet verified.

annotations.basis: Recorded action (1 DIRECT + 2 NAME_RESOLUTION) checked the three nearest sushi candidates by distance (189 m, 209 m, 197 m): Sumi Sushi Shibuya (Google website = Tabelog 13293469, DIRECT), Shibuya Sushi Labo (own website, NAME_RESOLUTION) and Sushi-Au (no website, NAME_RESOLUTION). The context offered 8 checkable in-radius DIRECT candidates, e.g. Sushi Tatsu Shibuya 191 m, Shibuya Sushi Jinnan 328 m, Sushi kazumasa 451 m, Sushi Matsumoto Shibuya 632 m (a later-certified witness). The decision context did not expose which candidates had a direct source page, so the Agent ranked by distance alone. Mapping from candidate IDs to source IDs was taken from the frozen run artifact p20-h001-a1.result.json.gz, not from production eligibility labels.

acceptableActions.when: SELECTION_RULE. This context has exactly 3 checkable in-radius DIRECT candidates: Kagurazaka Jin 81 m (Google website = TableCheck shop), Sugata 107 m (Google website = Tabelog 13053749), 日本料理 ほそ川 神楽坂 95 m (Google website = Tabelog 13222581). All are Google japanese_restaurant; none has verified kaiseki yet.
Targets at least 2 of those DIRECT candidates to verify the kaiseki HARD criterion.

Under the rule, keeping Utou (explicit 'Kaiseki' in its name) plus 2 DIRECT candidates is acceptable.

replayGate.rule: After the availabilityPath change, with each seed replayed once on the real model: (1) p22-selection-001 (Kagurazaka) must be ACCEPTABLE; (2) at least 2 of the 3 SHIBUYA_OMAKASE seeds (p1-seed-0134, p22-selection-002, p22-selection-003) must be ACCEPTABLE; (3) the control p1-seed-0133 must remain ACCEPTABLE. The three Shibuya seeds are near-duplicates of one scenario, so they are not counted as independent evidence.
replayGate.baselineExpectation: With the recorded actions, (1) and (2) fail and (3) passes.
replayGate.pendingAnnotation: Any further implementer-extracted seed stays NOT_EVALUATED until annotated here.

revisionNote: Revision 2 (before any replay was run): the selection rule is relaxed from "all selected must be DIRECT" to "at least 2 selected must be DIRECT" so that one explicitly name-matching NAME_RESOLUTION candidate is not penalised; adds p22-selection-001/002/003; scores the h001 family as one scenario.
